trial_court: Judge, Family Court, Pauri Garhwal in Family Court Case No. 60 of 2018
case_name: Smt. Shakuntala Umrao vs Ram Sharan Umrao
facts_of_case: The parties got married on 05.02.2016 but the wife filed for divorce under Section 13(1)(ia) and (ib) of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 due to alleged cruelty by the husband.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party alleging cruelty to prove it by substantial evidence.
legal_principles.held: While deciding Issue No. 1 against the appellant, the Judge, Family Court, Pauri Garhwal recorded a finding that from the contentions of the parties and the evidence on record, it is clear that the marriage of the appellant and the respondent had been solemnized with the consent of the parties and their family members; there were healthy marital relationship between the parties.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not grant relief of divorce on the basis of desertion without substantial evidence.
legal_principles.held: In such a situation, on the basis of desertion under Section 13(1)(i-b) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, the relief of divorce cannot be granted to the appellant.

outcome.final_order: The appeal was allowed and the trial court's decision dismissing the divorce petition was set aside.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
